typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT ResultSet = CAST(CONCAT(ProductionDate,\'|\',MedicaidId,\'|\',FirstName,\'|\',MiddleName,\'|\',LastName,\'|\',DOB,\'|\',HomePhone,\'|\',CellPhone,\'|\',HomeAddress,\'|\',HomeCity,\'|\', 							   HomeState,\'|\',HomeZIPCode,\'|\',ProviderNPI,\'|\',ProviderFullName,\'|\',ProviderSpecialty,\'|\',ProviderGroupTIN,\'|\',ProviderGroupName,\'|\',ProviderPhone,\'|\', 							   ProviderAddress,\'|\',ProviderCity,\'|\',ProviderState,\'|\',ProviderZIP,\'|\',DateOfService,\'|\',CPTCode,\'|\',CPTCodeDescription,\'|\',POSCode,\'|\',POSCodeDescription) AS VARCHAR(MAX))   FROM EXTRACT.DMO_TX_Stage_Data  WHERE (RowIndicator = \'HEADER\' OR MCNADental = \'Y\')  ORDER BY RowIndicator DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetExtractData
GetExtractData derive(c_ResultSet = ResultSet) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive(c_ResultSet = c_ResultSet) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ResultSet = c_ResultSet)) ~> ExtractDatatoOutbound
